title: An immunosensor for the detection of N-(carboxymethyl)lysine - a diabetic biomarker

Priyanga Kumar, Noel Nesakumar, Srinivasan Vedantham, John Bosco Balaguru Rayappan
Developed an electrochemical immunosensor for the rapid and ultralow-level detection of carboxymethyl-lysine using the surface-modified glassy carbon electrode with carbon quantum dots synthesised using orange peel powder via a hydrothermal process.
